$description: CiNQ design tokens 2.0.0. The only hand-authored token file. Dark values are $value; light and high-contrast values are in $extensions['cinq.modes']. Aliases use {path.to.token}. Provenance tags follow DECISIONS.md: canonical, derived, proposed.

primitive.$description: Raw colours. Never used directly in a product; semantic tokens alias them.

1.$description: canonical. The canvas. Warm near-black, never #000.

2.$description: canonical. Raised: cards, panels, the header pill.

deep.$description: derived. A well below the canvas for inputs and table bodies.

1.$description: canonical. Type and the wordmark. Never #fff.

3.$description: canonical. Mono labels. Large text only.

white.$description: derived. The one permitted white: an input surface on paper.

neutral.$description: derived (D-010). Twelve warm steps between bone and ink, every canonical neutral included.

vermilion.$description: derived (D-011). Hue locked at OKLCH 36°. 500 is the canonical accent.

text-paper.$description: canonical. Vermilion as small text on paper. 5.21:1.

deep.$description: canonical. Print shadows and the OG gradient only.

amber.$description: canonical. Inside the hero light and the OG image only. Never UI.

rose-shader.$description: canonical. The fourth ribbon colour in the shader. Never UI.

400.$description: derived (D-012). Danger, distinct from the accent.

black.$description: derived. Scrims and shadows only, always with alpha.

semantic.$description: What a product uses. Every token has a light value. High-contrast overrides where the pair would otherwise fall below 7:1.

sunken.$description: An input well, a table body.

bezel.$description: The fourth step; marketing device bezels.

device.$description: canonical (19 Sep). A phone frame. Same in both modes.

footer.$description: canonical. The footer is ink in both modes.

tertiary.$description: 3.67:1. Large text and mono labels only.

inverse.$description: On a bone slab or tooltip.

on-accent.$description: canonical. Text on vermilion is ink. Both modes.

fill.$description: canonical. Buttons, the mark, colour blocks.

text.$description: canonical. Vermilion as small text. 6.44:1 on ink.

standard.$description: canonical. Inputs at rest, ghost buttons.

disabled-opacity.$description: Disabled controls keep their colour at 40%.

ios.$description: derived. iOS with the system fallback.

light.$description: canonical. The footer wordmark's lightest pole. Never static text.

size.$description: Fluid sizes as written on the site (canonical) plus the app roles (derived). rem at 16px.

typography.$description: Composite roles. Each is font, size, line-height, weight, tracking. px equivalents are in typography.md.

shadow.$description: Large, soft, tinted to ink, or none. There is no medium shadow (canonical rule). Light-mode alphas halve.

slab.$description: derived. A card lifting on hover.

screen.$description: canonical. Qeemat screens in the products card.

bezel-top.$description: canonical. The 1px top light on a core.

card-print.$description: canonical. Business card in the kit.

recede.$description: canonical. A pinned card under the next.

word-dim.$description: canonical. Studio words before they light.

3xl.$description: canonical (19 Sep). Large displays. 2xl is a laptop and keeps the laptop layout.

density.$description: derived (D-024). Set data-density on a surface root.

gradient.$description: derived catalog of canonical instances (D-015). Every UI gradient is one token colour to transparent. angle/shape/at/interp are in $extensions['cinq.gradient']. Two-hue gradients are the shader stand-ins only.

scrim-hero.$description: canonical G1. Legibility under hero copy.

glow-cursor.$description: canonical G3. 52vmax disc, mix-blend screen, dark only.

cinq.gradient.use: One per page, marketing dark mode only.

ring-spotlight.$description: canonical G4. Masked to a 1px ring; the 90% is the hover peak, 0 at rest.

ring-spotlight-inverse.$description: canonical G4 inverse (19 Sep). On an accent-washed card.

portrait-fade.$description: canonical G6. Legibility over a portrait.

wash-accent.$description: canonical G8. Fades out on hover.

wash-ink-reverse.$description: canonical G9. In on hover; the reverse of wash-accent.

dots.$description: canonical G10. 1px dots on an 18px grid at opacity 0.4.

corner-fade.$description: canonical G11. Fades a texture toward a corner.

backlight-amber.$description: canonical G13. Illustration only, never UI.

og-ribbon-1.$description: canonical G14. The one two-hue gradient outside the shader.

shimmer.$description: derived. Skeleton shimmer, 200% wide, travels once per 1.6s.

live-edge.$description: derived. A 2px left edge on a new console row, fades over 2s.

scrim-sheet.$description: derived. Flat scrim as a gradient token for platforms that need one.

press.$description: canonical. Transform on a button, roll text.

reveal.$description: canonical. Founder strip, menu links, sheet.

out.$description: canonical. expo.out. Everything that moves on its own.

in-out.$description: canonical. Things that open then close.

linear.$description: canonical. Scrubbed tweens and the marquee only.

spring.$description: canonical values from the site; $type spring is a CiNQ extension. linear() approximations are generated.

transition.$description: Composite: duration, timingFunction, delay. Which one a component uses is in transitions-and-choreography.md.

motion.$description: Keyframe references. $value is the animation name; the keyframes are in $extensions['cinq.keyframes'] and generated into motion.css.

weight-wave.$description: canonical (19 Sep). Footer wordmark on touch.

gradient-drift.$description: derived. Ambient drift on an oversized layer, marketing only.
